figurative_meaning_bn: উৎসন্নে যাও; কিছু করতে না পেরে ব্যর্থ হয়ে পড়ে থাকো; ফাঁকিতে পড়ো
figurative_meaning_en: Become despondent; fail at something and remain idle; get stuck in a dilemma
example_sentences_in_bangla: পরীক্ষায় খারাপ ফল করার পর সে কলা খেয়ে বসে রইল।
কাজে ব্যর্থ হয়ে সে কলা খাওয়ার মতো অবস্থায় পড়েছে।
example_sentences_in_english: After getting poor results in the exam, he just sat there eating bananas, meaning he became idle.
Having failed at the task, he ended up in a state of eating bananas, implying he was stuck and despondent.
note: The idiom draws from the image of idly eating a banana when one is unable to act or has failed, common in colloquial Bengali speech.
